title: Recording: Silver Horse, Cleanup Time, Beautiful Boy (Darling Boy) by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

The sixth recording session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 13 August 1980.

Three tracks were worked on, two of which were included on the album. The first was Ono’s ‘Silver Horse’, which was released on 1981’s Season Of Glass.

It was followed by the recording of the backing track for Lennon’s ‘Cleanup Time’, and an overdub of steel drum onto ‘Beautiful Boy (Darling Boy)’, the latter played by Robert Greenidge.

That was one of my arrangements and it really came off, the way it was colored and structured. Sean came by at least three or four times a week and the song was played for him in the studio.
Jack Douglas, producer, Double Fantasy
Starting Over, Ken Sharp
Harmonically, it’s [‘Cleanup Time’] very adventurous. I forgot how tricky it was. It’s a fantastic track. I love the horn parts on it. It has a sort of ‘Tomorrow Never Knows’ ending, that slice of life mélange, snippets of musique concrète.
George Small, keyboards, Double Fantasy
Starting Over, Ken Sharp
